fields.FIR_Description: On 2025-03-18 at about 12:45, it was reported that a series of small debits adding up to Rs. 12,00,000 appeared in the statement of the complainant without any authorisation. The online submission was made by Lavanya Ammal (9000000175). Praveen Natarajan (9000000041) was mentioned as a person who was present nearby. Mathan Raman (9000000187), described as an intermediary, was also mentioned in the complaint. Nandha Karuppasamy (mobile 9000000113) was named as a possible person of interest. The complainant mentioned the account SYN-ACC-100024 as the destination of the transfer. The complainant mentioned physical documents.
fields.Modus_Operandi: Multiple small transfers reportedly made in quick succession.
fields.Keywords: bank fraud, unauthorised transaction, apartment complex, afternoon, documents, receiving account, suspect, associate
